chapter: A Gifted Rose: Prickly as Thorns
act_title: A Gifted Rose: Prickly as Thorns

quests.title: A Gifted Rose: Prickly as Thorns

dialogue.t: What are you kids doing? Come to laugh at this old man "growing rocks," have you?
I'm fine! I don't need the other villagers to worry about me.
Whoa, no need to be so hostile from the get-go.
You're mistaken. We're not from Aaru Village, and we're not here to laugh at you.

dialogue.sit: I heard that someone's growing flowers here.

dialogue.t: Passers-by? Uh...
Normally, only some old friends of mine would come over to tell me to give up on the nursery and move back to the village.
And a few bad kids too. They keep coming over here to cause trouble.
It's my first time seeing children dressed up like this. What is it that you do?

dialogue.sit: I'm a traveler looking for my family.
I'm an adventurer exploring the world.

dialogue.t: Yes, we've traveled a long way for this, and gone through many adventures together.
{NICKNAME}'s a righteous soul through and through.
We don't do things like bullying lonely old folks.
So there's no need to worry, gramps. We're not bad guys.
Ahem. How embarrassing, to have to apologize to two children. But I am sorry. I shouldn't have made assumptions.
Children, please accept my — Affan's — most sincere apologies.
You children are very capable to be supporting yourselves at such a young age. Quite impressive. Much better than me at your age.
So based on what you just said, I can request your help when I have a problem that I can't solve, yes?
Oh? Do you mean you have a commission for us?
I originally had two nurseries. One is here, and the other is to the west of the village.
I've gotten quite old, so it's getting harder for me to tend to both places. I didn't check on the other nursery for just a few days, and it was destroyed by some strange black stuff.
It's terribly dangerous. Once I went in, I thought I wouldn't be able to come back out. I know better than to try to go in there again.
My greatest hope now is to restore that nursery so that I can grow flowers there again.
It doesn't sound too complicated. What do you think? Should we accept this commission, {NICKNAME}?
The nursery is to the west of the village. Don't get lost!
No problem! Don't worry about it.
The nursery is to the west of the village. Give it a try, and see if you can save it.
You two are back? How is the nursery? Do you think it can be saved?

dialogue.sit: You explain the Withering to Affan.

dialogue.t: I see. So that's why. I knew something was off when so much black stuff just appeared out of the ground.
Good, good. Now I can finally plant some seeds without worries.
When these three seeds sprout, bloom and produce seeds again, I'll plant them in the ground there. Then the land will be covered with these flowers.
Eh? These strangely-shaped rocks...? Can flowers grow out of them?
Where did you buy these from, Grandpa Affan? Did you get scammed or something?
You have good hearts. But don't worry, children. Mora can't buy these flower seeds.
The old... I mean, a friend of mine gave me these three precious seeds. So of course they are different from normal seedlings.
The more Paimon hears about it, the weirder it sounds. Grandpa Affan, just what are you growing?
Hehe, what I'm planting is a friend's wish.
What a strange answer. Can you really plant that sort of thing?
Child, you wouldn't understand even if I told you. Come visit me again when you get the chance.
This field might look empty now, but these three seeds will one day sprout and bloom in this nursery.
There will be more and more of them in the future. Haha, and they will surely create a beautiful scene.
Alright, alright. Since I asked for your help, I will be sure to compensate you.
Take this, children. I can't give you much, so this is all.
Phew, commission complete! Paimon's a little hungry after all that running around.

dialogue.sit: I was the one running though...

dialogue.t: Well, Paimon was providing running commentary. That takes energy too!
Don't sweat the small stuff! How about we use our payment to buy ourselves a treat, hmm?
C'mon, let's see how much we got and how many meals we can buy.
Ah, most of the stuff here is food instead of Mora... Shawarma, Tahchin, and lots of vegetables.
This is way too much. Did we take a whole day's rations away from Grandpa Affan?
But he lives alone outside the village. It can't be easy for him, right?
Never mind the Mora. If he gave us all his rations, then... It just feels wrong.
And he was planting seeds that looked like stones, saying that he was planting... a wish?
Is it possible that he's been living on his own for so long that he's started to imagine things?
This is worrying. Let's pay him a visit when we can find the time.
Phew, commission complete! Paimon's a little hungry after all that running around.

quests.description: The old man who lives alone on the outskirts of the village may be the flower grower mentioned by Sabbah. Help him clean up his nursery.
